rule: A scientific source_commit must be an ancestor of the pinned commit in the recorded protected-main snapshot or equal the commit pinned by an explicitly registered immutable evidence ref. recorded_ref names where the snapshot was observed; it is historical metadata, not a mutable ref that must continue resolving to the old commit.
limits: Git object existence alone is not scientific provenance.
A deleted source branch is not an immutable evidence ref.
Updating the protected_main snapshot is an explicit repository-governance change.
